title: Undead Unluck
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fuuko Izumo, 18, whose 'Unluck' brings disaster on anyone she touches, plans to end her life after finishing a favorite manga, until she meets Andy, an undead man who regenerates from anything and longs for a proper death. Hunted and then recruited by the Union, an organization of people with rule-breaking powers, they join a fight to break God's cycle of destroying and remaking the world.
life_message: It holds up choosing to live, and fighting fate together, as worth more than any single loss.
